named_subject: a spider (round body with short leg lines radiating from it) hanging on web threads
action: The spider stays near the centre where two web threads meet and shifts a small distance right, left and right again between frames, with its legs holding the same pose throughout.
identity_gap: The body oval, the long lower-left leg pair, and the short upper-right leg strokes match c.png closely. The drawing is smaller and slightly tilted, and a few leg ends are shortened, but it reads as the same doodle.
notes: The film spider turns and stretches its legs out wide while the drawing only slides as a fixed shape, jumping position at frames 4, 5, 7 and 8; the web threads also break into gaps in frames 5 to 7. The change that would help most is to animate the leg strokes extending and the body rotating as in the film, and to move the body in small even steps instead of jumps.
